name: zinterp_context_handle_builtin_command
description: zInterp_Context::HandleBuiltinCommand handles zInterp meta commands and the recursive source include path.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zInterp parser/runtime source-cluster pass.
HandleBuiltinCommand participates in the recursive zInterp execution loop with RunScriptFile, RunString, and RunStream, so dependency acceptance is made for the group rather than as an isolated leaf.
Binary Ninja has an inline strcmp flag-lift warning in the Quit comparison; source keeps exact Quit matching while other builtin keywords use the observed fixed-length strncmp behavior.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja MLIL for 0x4c1c50 validates conditional-depth handling, ifdef/ifndef, mkdir errno reporting, exact Quit handling, set/source/who/var builtin behavior, and fallback to core dispatch.
Native smokes cover macro setting, conditional skipping, var assignment, Quit parse termination, unknown-command fallthrough, RunStream integration, and nested source execution.
